Thanks for the PR. Before a reviewer picks it up, a few things from [CONTRIBUTION_POLICY.md](https://github.com/future-agi/future-agi/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTION_POLICY.md) need fixing. This check re-runs on every push and edit.

**To fix:**
- Linked issue is not labelled `accepted` yet. A maintainer needs to accept the issue before the PR is reviewed (policy rule 1). Comment on the issue if it's been quiet.

If you think a check is wrong, say so here and a maintainer will override it.
